en: An unlicensed driver holds keys and an empty license sleeve while an official blocks access to the car.
ja: 免許のない人が車の鍵と空の免許ケースを見せ、係員が車の利用を止めている。
prompt:
Subject: unlicensed, target meaning "無認可の".

Composition: A driver has car keys but an empty license-card sleeve, while an official refuses access to the vehicle.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded 2D shapes, smooth solid colors and restrained cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep every part inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
Use attached invidious.png for drawing style only: thick rounded dark brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D forms. Exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands per person, normal compact forearm proportions. Clean smooth solid colors and restrained flat shadows. No watercolor grain, muddiness, speckles, mottling, paper texture, bleed or fuzzy edges. Transparent background, no detached ground shadows. All silhouettes clean closed dark brown outlines. 512x512 PNG RGBA.
